scope: Standing exterior at Tytuvėnai. The rectangular chapel has a low tile-gabled body, a taller square bay with a steep hipped cap, white plaster, pale pilasters and low splayed buttresses.

originalReview.notes: The courtyard view shows the tall square bay with a steep four-sided dark roof, long low tiled body, white plaster and battered base buttresses. The twin towers behind it establish the church side profile.

quallaSearch.notes: The selected photographs match the originals published by Qualla. Their sole uploader released them to the public domain. The historic silhouettes and massing survive the documented roof and facade work. Current small finish details are estimated.
